desc: Prove the characterization of legal moves in terms of bipartite connected components and their two color-class sizes.
Analyze the impartial game and derive the winning-state invariant, including the flexible even-N case.
Find a compact formula for the winner based on component bipartition data and total vertex count.
Design an O(N+M) algorithm using iterative BFS, including isolated vertices.
Validate the corrected rule with exhaustive small game states and the provided examples.
